headline: Base Swaps Surge Across Fronts as Casualties Mount
war_summary: Since the 1200 edition the pace of strategic‑base exchanges has quickened further. Weathered Expanse now records fifty‑one ownership changes in the last twenty‑four hours, with Colonial and Warden casualties both climbing past six hundred per hour and enlistments accelerating. Nevish Line follows closely with forty‑two flips and casualty rates exceeding six hundred per hour for each side, also accelerating, while enlistments surge. Linn Mercy, previously cooling, shows thirty‑seven flips and rapidly rising losses for both factions. Mooring County, quiet in the last dispatch, has produced twenty‑four flips and rising casualty counts. Marban Hollow maintains a high turnover near twenty‑one events, with Warden casualties accelerating. Stonecradle adds eight flips and modestly accelerating enlistments. Meanwhile Callahans Passage and Dead Lands continue to bleed heavily with no base movement, and the majority of rear‑area hexes remain static. Kuura Strand and Stlican Shelf each see only a handful of changes.
